# BRAIN ABSCESS WITH NOCARDIA SPP.

Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) should be obtained in all patients with
suspected brain abscess for diagnosis and determining number of lesions. Prior
to beginning antimicrobial therapy, when possible, computed topographic (CT) -
guided aspiration or surgery should be performed to obtain abscess material for
determination of infectious pathogen.

Nocardia brain abscesses typically occur in immunocompromised patients and is
often concomitant with disseminated or pulmonary infection. May occur with
meningitis and/or ventriculitis.

# Consult Neurosurgery, Neurology, and Infectious Disease

# Duration of Therapy

Treat with IV therapy for total duration of 3-6 weeks in immunocompetent and 6
weeks in immunocompromised patients. Switch to oral antimicrobials after
completing IV therapy and treat for an additional 3 months or more (longer for
meningitis, immunocompromise or extensive disease).

# Initial IV Therapy

[Sulfamethoxazole 75 mg/kg - trimethoprim 15 mg/kg IV q8h \($$$\) R,DI <AND>](orz-set-abx-tmp-smz-15-75mg-kg-iv-q8h-imipenem-1gm-iv-q8h)

imipenem 1000 mg IV q8h ($$) [R]

If Nocardia isolate is susceptible to third generation cephalosporins
[Sulfamethoxazole 75 mg/kg - trimethoprim 15 mg/kg IV q8h \($$$\) R,DI <AND>](orz-set-abx-tmp-smz-25-75mg-kg-iv-q8h-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q12h)

ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h ($) [M]

If multiorgan or rapidly progressive disease, in addition to above therapy
[< ADD > Amikacin 7.5 mg/kg IV q12h \($$\)](psjizid-amikacin-7-5-mg-kg-iv-q12h)

Alternative
[Linezolid 600 mg IV q12h \($$$$\) DI,O < AND > imipenem 1 gm IV q8h \($$\) R](orz-set-abx-linezolid-600mg-iv-q12h-imipenem-1gm-iv-q8h)

# Oral Therapy, After Completing IV Therapy Above

For immunocompetent patients, treat with one of the below PO antimicrobials for
at least 3 months after initial IV treatment. For immunocompromised patients,
Treat with 2 of the below antimicrobials for at least one year.

[Sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim 2 DS PO q12h \($\) R,DI](psjzid-trimeth-sulfa-2ds-po-q12h)

< OR >
[Minocycline 100mg q12h\($\) DI](psjzid-minocycline-100mg-po-q12h)

< OR >
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h \($\) R](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)
